description: This file contains React hooks for managing submissions in an LMS platform, including loading submissions, creating/updating submissions, and grading submissions. It interacts with a Supabase backend and handles user roles such as students, instructors, and admins.

methods.name: useSubmissions(assignmentId)
methods.description: Custom React hook to load submissions for a specific assignment. It fetches data from the Supabase backend and filters submissions based on user role (student or instructor/admin).

methods.name: useSubmissionMutations(assignmentId, { onLocalUpdate } = {})
methods.description: Custom React hook providing functionalities to students to submit/update their work and for instructors/admins to grade submissions. It handles side effects and local optimistic updates.

methods.name: fetchSubmissions
methods.description: Inner function within useSubmissions that performs the fetch query for submissions based on assignmentId and user role.

methods.name: submitWork
methods.description: Function to submit or update a student's assignment. Performs optimistic updates and communicates with the backend.

methods.name: gradeSubmission
methods.description: Function to grade a submission, restricted to instructors and admins. Updates grade points and feedback.
